workflow_selection_rule: Sort qualifying native health-data acquisition workflow IDs; interpret first 16 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 of UTF-8 prefix plus case ID as a base-16 integer, modulo count; zero-based index. Metadata-only functions and parameter variants are not separate health-data acquisition workflows.
execution_limits: Fixed per-case controls: 3 active executor hours, 6 elapsed hours, 4 VM-hours, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB RAM, 100 GiB disk, 20 GiB network. Include reference capture in case meters. One transient retry OR one diagnostic repeat; preserve the initial outcome.
execution_safety: Disposable unprivileged isolation and access/safety qualification required before attempts; no source patches, alternate source, maintainer contact or protected records.
executor_supervisor_freeze: Executor assignment, documentation, model, tools, output location and reference window remain to be frozen by the coordinator; major scientific claims require human review.
assessment: Independent assessment and oracle not prepared; kept outside this executor-facing case file. No health payload obtained.
system_identity: CDC public environmental health tracking R interface; distinct steward, code and source endpoint from CMU Delphi Python client. No identified OSRI team authorship; independent human eligibility review pending.

software_revision.basis: Latest stable tagged release, published 2023-07-27; tagged DESCRIPTION says package Version 1.0.0: mismatch retained.

workflow_inventory.description: Retrieve CDC Tracking Network measure data; measure, geography, stratification and temporal options are parameter variants.

workflow_inventory_limit: The list_* and update_inventory functions retrieve source metadata inventories, not measured health data; get_data is the one health-observation acquisition entrypoint at this revision.

task.basis: First documented measure-data example in tagged README, explicit one measure and stratification, remaining arguments default. No invented subsetting.
task.token: No token; anonymous mode, do not solicit token

runtime.requirements: R >=3.5.0; httr >=1.4.0, dplyr >=0.8.0.1, purrr >=0.3.0, jsonlite >=1.5, lifecycle. Exact compatible package versions and size unverified.
runtime.revision_constraint: Pinned installation is coordinator-managed environment configuration; dependency versions remain unfrozen. README uses floating default branch; tagged DESCRIPTION version mismatch retained.

source_identity.publisher: CDC National Environmental Public Health Tracking Network
source_identity.request: POST https://ephtracking.cdc.gov:443/apigateway/api/v1/getCoreHolder/ plus measure, stratification, smoothing and generated geography/time filters; metadata requests also required.
source_identity.version: Current response for historical observation years; no immutable release identity established.
source_identity.access: Tagged README says token optional and throttling may occur. No token acquisition or author contact.
source_identity.risk: https://ephtracking.cdc.gov/ reports Data Explorer maintenance; this does not prove API outage. Current API and selected measure untested.

example_selection.corpus: Revision-matched README Accessing Tracking Network data section.
example_selection.ranking: basic_state_measure_99 is the uniquely designated basic state-level example; remaining sections explicitly introduce advanced options or specific geography and period filters.
example_selection.seed: Not used; no tie in highest-ranked basic example.
